L01.drivers: Profile shows a pronounced S-curve: upper chest pushes far forward, back is rounded into a hump, the waist is sharply pinched, and the pelvis sits back. Knees are flexed and the shins are curved. The front view is narrow with thin, long arms and slightly flared thighs. Overall it reads as a different body plan rather than just a thin human.
limb_cues: long thin arms hanging forward of trunk

L02.drivers: Broad, soft, fuller female-type build: wide shoulders, thick limbs, mild chest. Upright, straight leg axis, ordinary transitions.

L03.drivers: Heavier male-type build with a slight belly. In profile the torso is deep, with a prominent rear bulge (buttocks/lower back). Legs are straight and joints look ordinary. It might be a heavier variant (B) but stays within ordinary range.

L04.drivers: Slim, ordinary proportions; straight upright profile.

L05.drivers: Average build with ordinary proportions and an upright profile.

L06.drivers: Average build with ordinary proportions and an upright profile.

L07.drivers: Male-type build with a deep, thick torso in profile, a strong back, and a buttock bulge. Limbs and posture are ordinary. Similar to L03.

L08.drivers: Strongly pear-shaped: narrow shoulders and thin arms against very wide hips and thick upper thighs. Smooth, low-definition surfaces and a full chest in profile. Probably an extreme human female shape; it could be a distinct type, but the joints and posture look ordinary.
axial_cues: very wide pelvis/hips relative to shoulders
limb_cues: thick upper thighs tapering to thin calves

L11.drivers: Same organization as L01, but stronger. The upper torso is a barrel/hump, with the chest projecting forward and the back strongly convex. Waist is pinched, the pelvis is set back, and the knees are flexed with curved shins. In the front view the upper trunk is broad and blocky while the hips and legs are thin.

L12.drivers: Broad-shouldered, slightly larger male-type build. Profile is upright with an ordinary buttock curve.

distinguishing_features: Only one non-human group is evident (L01 and L11). Both have a barrel or hunched upper trunk, a sharply pinched waist, the pelvis set back, and bent knees with curved shins. L11 is the more extreme of the two. L08 is the next most unusual (extreme hip-to-shoulder ratio), but its posture and joints look human.
